spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A four-pawed jaguar chimera with a cream eagle head, hooked gold beak, wide fully-feathered painted wings and a plumed tail, covered in Oaxacan alebrije flowers, dots, chevrons and ink outlines.
spec.layout: The creature stands on four chunky jaguar paws resting on y=0: front paws at z≈0.85, back paws at z≈-0.55. The orange jaguar torso runs z=-0.9 to z=1.0, chest lifted, belly sagging to y≈0.6, with a tall feathered chest ruff at the base of the neck. The neck rises forward to a big cream eagle head at [0,1.65,1.5] with large amber eyes on the sides, a big hooked gold beak pointing forward-down (tip z≈2.06, upper beak fixed, lower jaw a separate joint held open), and a fan crest of flat feathers rising from the back of the skull to y≈2.25. Two huge fully-feathered wings extend sideways and slightly up from the shoulder mounts at [±0.34,1.5,0.55], arms to x≈±1.9, seven long primaries fanning back so the wing tips reach x≈±2.5, y≈2.3, z≈-0.6. The tail leaves the rump at [0,1.18,-0.88], dips to y≈1.0, curls up to a tail tip at [0,1.38,-2.2] crowned with a parrot-style feather plume. Style on every part: flat vivid painted-wood colour blocks, toothed zigzag edges between coat and belly, paired ink-and-cream dots down flanks and wings, chevron bands, lathed concentric flower medallions on shoulders, cheeks and haunches, ink outlines on every feather and band.

parts.builds: Jaguar body and neck, chest ruff and painted body motifs. Sweep the torso along the spine: chest at z≈0.9 (r≈0.5), mid at z≈0.15 (r≈0.55, belly sagging to y≈0.62), rump at z≈-0.75 (r≈0.48), rounded cap at the tail base mount; the belly hangs below the spine (use shift) while the bones stay on the spine line. Neck: a tapered tube from the shoulders up and forward to the neckTop mount (r 0.3 to 0.22). Coat: coatMain above the belly, with a toothed zigzag fur edge separating it from belly on the chest and underbelly; coatDeep shading on the lowest underbelly surface for carved depth. Painted over the coat: two rows of paired Oaxacan dots down each flank (small ink dot with a cream inner dot, repeating along the body), a chevron band of belly triangles marching across the back at z≈0.2 and another at z≈-0.35, thin ink wave lines on the rump. Eagle chest ruff at the neck base: two layers of flat extruded feather slabs fanning down over the chest from z≈0.85 to z≈0.55, outer layer belly, inner layer cream, each slab with an ink tip and a thin bone shaft line. Shoulder medallions: lathed concentric discs (cream, flowerGreen ring, ink ring, flowerMagenta centre) seated on each shoulder blade at [±0.5,1.35,0.35]. Neck finish: a single wingTeal collar band with cream chevrons just below the neckTop mount. Rides body and neck joints.
parts.attaches: Neck tube ends exactly at mount neckTop where the eagleHead begins; tail sweeps away from the rump at mount tailBase; thigh tops of the legs part sit under mounts hipFrontL/R and hipBackL/R inside the torso box bottom.

parts.builds: Eagle head, hooked beak, jaw, eyes and crest. Skull: a rounded head built from a lathed dome plus cheek spheres, centred at [0,1.65,1.5], cream head with a coatMain crown patch on top and a coatMain nape patch at the back. Eyes (the signature feature, big and readable from the front): on each side of the skull at [±0.15,1.72,1.66] a white sclera disc, eyeAmber iris, ink pupil with a white highlight dot, and an ink outline ring; bold ink brow strokes angled above each eye. Cheek discs: lathed concentric painted circles (wingTeal outer ring, cream, flowerMagenta centre) seated on each cheek below the eyes. Upper beak: a big hooked beak sweeping from the cere at [0,1.58,1.68] down to the hook tip at [0,1.42,2.06], beakGold, with an ink nostril slit and a cream stripe down the culmen; a wingTeal cere band at its base. Lower jaw: on joint jawLower, a wedge lower beak in beakGold hanging below the upper beak, held open in the rest pose showing a mouthDark interior wedge and a small flowerRed tongue. Crest: a fan of 6 flat extruded feathers rising from the back of the skull up to y≈2.25, alternating wingTeal, wingBlue and featherRed, each ink-edged with a cream tip and a bone shaft line. Back-of-head feather ruff: small cream flat slabs flowing down into the torso's neck ruff so the head and neck read as one feathered transition. Rides head and jawLower joints.
parts.attaches: Head base sits on mount neckTop at the end of the torso neck tube; the lower jaw pivots at mount jawPivot; nothing of this part passes in front of the eyes.

parts.builds: Both wings, fully extended in rest pose for rigging, mirrored. Each wing: upper-arm tube from the shoulder mount to wingL2 and forearm tube from wingL2 to wingLtip, tapering r 0.13 to 0.07, coatMain with two wingTeal band rings at the elbow and wrist, plus a thin bone leading-edge ridge along the arm's front. Covert layer: one row of small rounded covert feathers along the arm (belly with ink tips) seated on the tube. Primaries: 7 long flat extruded feather slabs fanning from the wrist/tip back toward z≈-0.6, reaching x≈±2.5, alternating wingTeal and wingBlue, each with a wingDeep tip, an ink shaft line down the middle and two cream notch cutouts near the tip; feather tips staggered in length like flight feathers. Secondaries: 6 shorter feathers along the inner trailing edge from the arm back to the body, belly with a cream zigzag band across them and ink edges. Wing root pauldrons: lathed concentric disc (coatMain, cream ring, ink ring, flowerCyan centre) over each shoulder mount, hiding the arm root. Scattered small cream dots between the feather rows on the wing surface. Rides all six wing joints per side.
parts.attaches: Wing arms root at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR on the torso shoulders; feather fans hang clear of the torso box, tail and legs.

parts.builds: Four legs and paws, standing on y=0. Front legs: a round thigh capsule at the hipFront mount blending into a slim swept shin down to the paw. Back legs: big haunches (r≈0.24) with a carved haunch disc pattern (belly rosette ring with flowerGreen centre) and a heavier thigh sweeping to the paw. All legs: coatMain above the knee, cream socks below it, ink chevron bands at knee and ankle, and paired flank dots on the haunches. Paws: chunky rounded paw blocks with four toes separated by thin ink gaps, each toe tipped with a small bone claw cone; flowerCyan toe pads seated on the front underside of each paw, ink sole. Ankle tufts: small sprays of flat cream feathers with featherRed tips at the back of each ankle, echoing the eagle half. Front paw toes at z≈0.88, back paw toes at z≈-0.55; the paw bottoms, not the claws, rest flat on y=0.
parts.attaches: Each leg's thigh tops rise into mounts hipFrontL/R and hipBackL/R under the torso; thigh surfaces continue the torso coat and dot pattern so the leg-torso seam is invisible.

parts.builds: Ringed tail and tip plume. Swept tapered tail from the tailBase mount on the rump: r 0.14 at the root, dipping to y≈1.0 at the second joint, then curling up to the tailTip at [0,1.38,-2.2] with r 0.04, coatMain along its length. Bold painted bands: cream rings at t≈0.3 and t≈0.65, wingTeal rings at t≈0.5 and t≈0.8, a thin ink outline ring between each band, and one flowerMagenta dot centred on each band's outer face. Dorsal feather spikes: a row of 6 small flat triangular spikes (featherRed with cream tips and ink edges) running along the top of the tail between root and tip. Tip plume: on the tailTip joint, 7 flat extruded feathers fanning up and back, alternating wingTeal, wingBlue and featherRed, each with an ink shaft, cream dots along its vane and a wingDeep tip, so the tail ends in a proud parrot-style plume.
parts.attaches: Tail root emerges from mount tailBase on the rump, buried into the torso cap; the plume stays clear of the legs box and the ground.

It should look like beautifully carved and painted wood.
3.  **Form:** A hybrid creature. A Jaguar base (feline body, powerful limbs, spotted/striped) merged with an Eagle structure (powerful wings, avian head, taloned feet).
4.  **Proportions:** Bold silhouette, expressive features, chunkiness balanced with organic flow. Since it's an alebrije, it should be dramatically posed, perhaps mid-flight or landing. Let's aim for a large, imposing figure.
